main_text.l: Non minus est factu, longéq; operosius illud, Si intellecta alios, scripta docere queas.
Ecquid in his rerū lateat, quid sit velacute Dictū, est solertis promere id artus opus.
Aonÿ cultor, doctusq; Heliconis alumnus, Hoc præstat studiis Marcus utrumq; suis: Dotibus ingenÿ instructus, monumenta diserti Aggressus, monstrat qd Ciceronis habet.
Illius & mēte, logices tibi & exprimit usum, Vsum permagnum Rethoricaq; docet.
Argumenta suis exquirens cuncta resolvit Acri iuditio, conspicienda locis.
Sive probent aliqd, sive ornët, amplificetq; Singula perpendit, quid valeatq; monet.
Deniq; sermonis, ceu pitta rosaria culti Lumina, perlustrans splendidiora rosis,
Quod Logicum, Logicæ: sic queis sunt verba figuris Tincta, tropos soli Rhetoricæ tribuit,
Quid pcul abstrusū est, solerti indagine totū Eruit in lucem, nilq; relinquit iners.
Obscura, illustrat: mixtas res ordine justo Separat à verbis, dexteritate pari.
Exemplum tanta cura vigilante libellus Dispositus, Marci sedulitatis habet.

page.notes: Line-initial Q, N and other ornamental capitals are set as printed. Several lines are rendered in long-s/round-s type; the text is copied with s kept where printed as a long s-form, though these may read as s in the source. Some words are doubtful at the ink edges, such as "Aonÿ", "Dotibus", "Illius & mēte" and "Dictū"; no [?] was added because the forms are legible but the scan is faint. Line "Quid pcul abstrusū" and "Obscura" are the most worn lines and may contain small errors.
